label: Start here card - the knobs

params.name: owner_sees
params.label: the portal owner sees the card too (it is for people starting work in a firm)

params.name: scan_most
params.label: most records whose History is counted for the done tests (a big firm's card stays quick)

params.name: ticks_stay
params.label: a step once done stays ticked, even if the record behind it is later removed

params.name: calls_most
params.label: most of the person's latest requests read for the steps' call patterns

params.name: needs_firm
params.label: the card waits until the person has a firm (the first screen is the choice alone)

description_nl: 2026-10-09 owner: a Start here card for a new user who has no idea how to proceed. The steps are the domain's chip start.steps; whether a step is done is chip start.done over facts core/startcard.py counts from real work.
